item.title: Sideprojects
item.description: Here are a few of my side projects! Link to heading In my space time I like to create a variety of small apps and side projects. Here are a few React based ones that live online. Memecycle Link to heading I am a heavy user of Strava and have created an alternative that gets great inspiration from pastebin.com. I wanted a site that would allow me to quickly upload GPS files and photos to share some of my bicycle rides.
